before_evidence: For a zero gradient coordinate and zero initial r_0, the RMSProp recurrence keeps r_t=0; the denominator is epsilon>0 and the coordinate update is zero. Zero gradient never creates a zero divisor.
after_evidence: Definition, the following declared clauses/formulas: `a denominator constant $\epsilon>0$`; `Set $r_0=0$.`; `r_{t,i}=\rho r_{t-1,i}+(1-\rho)g_{t,i}^2\qquad(1\le i\le d),`; `x_{t+1,i}=x_{t,i}-\eta_t\frac{g_{t,i}}{\sqrt{r_{t,i}}+\epsilon}\qquad(1\le i\le d).`. For a zero gradient coordinate and zero initial r_0, the RMSProp recurrence keeps r_t=0; the denominator is epsilon>0 and the coordinate update is zero. Zero gradient never creates a zero divisor.
